root.label: NYT investigation identifies Russian 20th Directorate sanctions network in Japan

events.label: NYT investigation identifies Russian 20th Directorate sanctions network in Japan

slots.name: attack deaths
slots.sentence: And in May, earlier this year, when these Ukrainian investigators were trawling through the debris of this awful attack on a residential building in Kyiv, that had killed 24 people, including children, they found Japanese components inside a missile that had destroyed the building.

slots.name: Japanese component share
slots.sentence: And the Ukrainian government estimates that 90 percent of Russian weapons, drones, missiles contain Japanese components.

slots.name: German component share
slots.sentence: We don’t have an exact number on the spies operating in Japan, in Tokyo, but we know there are a lot.
